title: Moss and the Mat
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters st, sw, tr.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog noticing a flat woven mat lying on the grass.
Moss the hedgehog dropping the flat mat down onto a bare patch of ground.
Moss the hedgehog stumbling as his foot catches the edge of the mat.
Moss the hedgehog sprawled flat on top of the mat after slipping.
Moss the hedgehog sitting on the mat looking glum.
Nell the bee flying over towards Moss, who is still sitting on the mat.
Nell the bee and Moss the hedgehog lifting the edge of the mat up together.
Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee smoothing the mat out flat on the ground.
Moss the hedgehog and Nell the bee sitting together on the neatly flattened mat.
